newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk may pay CSX $4.2 bln - WSJ. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Norfolk may pay CSX $4.2 bln - WSJ. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp could pay CSX Corp $4.2 billion as part of a tentative pact to end their lengthy takeover battle for Conrail, the Wall Street Journal said in its Tuesday electronic edition.
The report said the tentative agreement calls for CSX to then raise its existing offer for Conrail by $1 billion, thereby matching Norfolk Southern's $10.3 billion hostile offer for Conrail.
The friendly pact between CSX and Conrail (corrects from Norfolk) is presently valued at $9.6 billion or $108 a share.

People familiar with the negotiations told the paper that under the tentative plan, CSX, and possibly Norfolk Southern, would buy Conrail for $115 cash a share. The report said Conrail's shares would then be split about 50-50 between Norfolk Southern and CSX.
